mainEntity.name: What does a digital marketing company do?

acceptedAnswer.text: A digital marketing company plans, builds, and manages the channels that bring in customers online, including SEO, paid ads, content, email, and visibility in AI search results. Tekcroft handles strategy and execution for all of these under one plan.

mainEntity.name: How much does a digital marketing company cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the channels involved, your market, and the amount of work needed at the start. We will add the pricing range here. We provide exact pricing after reviewing your business in a free proposal.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right digital marketing company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look at how a company reports results, whether the same team stays on your account, and whether their strategy covers both traditional search and AI search. Ask to see real client results, not just a list of services.

mainEntity.name: What’s the difference between a digital marketing agency and a freelancer?

acceptedAnswer.text: A freelancer typically handles one channel, such as SEO or paid ads. A digital marketing agency runs multiple channels together and has the team and tools to scale a strategy as a business grows.

mainEntity.name: How long does digital marketing take to show results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paid advertising can produce results within weeks. SEO and AI search visibility typically take three to six months to show measurable movement, depending on the market and starting point.
